limitations: Visibility is geometric line of sight to the Sun and Earth centers against the stored terrain horizon; Sun disc width, refraction, eclipses, RF link budget and DSN scheduling are not modelled.
Durations have a resolution of one series step; windows start and end on grid epochs.
Results are only as accurate as the stored horizon and ephemeris series; check science_status and provenance per site.
Constraint thresholds are caller-declared assumptions, not mission requirements.
Consumables use constant per-person rates from crew.rate_source; no regeneration, leaks or EVA demand are modelled.

risks.explanation: Assumed constant load could not be served by the battery/solar budget.
Assumed battery reserve is reached or breached.

limitations: Educational ground simulation only: not an onboard flight computer, flight-ready navigation, or a NASA-certified mission tool.
Visibility time series and source names were supplied by the caller; no NASA LOLA, SPICE, or JPL data were authenticated.
Sun visibility is treated as fixed assumed electrical generation, ignoring incidence angle, eclipses, thermal conditions, dust and panel degradation.
Earth visibility is geometric only, not guaranteed radio contact, DSN availability, or an RF link-budget result.
Candidate selection compares ONLY supplied scenarios and assumed constraints; it cannot discover unprovided sites or flight trajectories.
